hint.Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: 使用更高環階的法術欄位

s: You summon a special homunculus in an unoccupied space within range. This creature uses the {@creature Homunculus Servant|EFA} stat block. If you already have a homunculus from this spell, the homunculus is replaced by the new one. You determine the homunculus's appearance, such as a mechanical-looking bird, winged vial, or miniature animate cauldron.

The homunculus is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.
